errors.text_span: Auf der horizontalen Achse sind drei Kategorien dargestellt: „keine Änderung“, „Arbeitsplätze abgebaut“ und „Arbeitsplätze geschaffen“. Auf der vertikalen Achse ist die Prozentzahl dargestellt, die von 0 bis 100 reicht, mit Intervallen von 20.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the horizontal and vertical axes. The horizontal axis shows the percentage values from 0 to 100, while the vertical axis lists the three categories.

The description incorrectly identifies the color for "Dienstleistungen ohne öffentlichen Dienst" as light grey ("hellgrau"). The legend and chart show this category is represented by a light blue bar.
The description incorrectly refers to the "keine Änderung" category as a single bar. The chart shows a group of three distinct bars for this category, representing the different sectors.

errors.text_span: und wird mit einer wellenlinienförmigen Textur dargestellt
errors.evidence: The description claims the bars have a "wavy line texture" ("wellenlinienförmigen Textur"), but the bars in the chart are solid-colored with no texture.

The description states the value for the "keine Änderung" category is approximately 96%. The actual values for the three bars in this group range from about 85% to 90%, all significantly lower than 96%.
The description incorrectly refers to the "Arbeitsplätze abgebaut" category as a single bar. The chart shows a group of three distinct bars for this category.

The description states the value for the "Arbeitsplätze geschaffen" category is approximately 2%. However, the values for the bars in this category range from approximately 8% to 10%. The value of 2% is closer to one of the bars in the "Arbeitsplätze abgebaut" category.

The description incorrectly refers to the "Arbeitsplätze geschaffen" category as a single bar. It also incorrectly states this bar is the shortest, when the bars for "Arbeitsplätze abgebaut" are visibly shorter.
